name: Tempo Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Unrack a barbell and brace hard.
Lower over a slow 3-4 count, staying tight and controlled.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive up at normal speed.
The slow eccentric builds control and muscle tension.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: An intermediate barbell squat-pattern exercise for the quadriceps. Tempo Squat (Barbell) develops leg strength through a full range of motion, which carries straight into daily life.
